segments.text: Ok so this is the headless threads page for AG2, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.

But the chat here has no agent ID, so umm, it runs on the default agent.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.

Moving on to the demo. It should list this conversation in the sidebar, but uh, the thread list stays empty, even after a reload.
So basically, the page says the sidebar shows your threads, but it stayed empty, because the two snippets use different agents.
And the sidebar never calls on select thread either, so a row couldn't open a thread anyway.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
